mapper.sql: mn.id as id, mn.id as qsscId, mn.pt_id as ptId, mn.p_id as pId, mn.con_id as conId, mn.te_id as teId, mn.qsc_remark as qscRemark, mn.create_time as createTime, mn.create_uid as createUid, mn.create_uname as createUname, mn.state as state, mn.state_time as stateTime
mapper.select: select con.Con_Name as conName, pro.P_Name as pName, con.Con_Code as conCode, con.Con_Money_Total as conMoneyTotal, proc.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, proc.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, prod.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId, qt.Qst_Name as qstName, qt.Qst_Code as qstCode, qt.Qst_Item as qstItem, qt.Qst_Is_Important as qstIsImportant, c1.C_Name as qsrDutyCpyName, u1.U_Name as rectifyUname, qr.*, qsscr.* from Qs_PT_Spot_Check_Record qsscr left join Qs_Record qr on qsscr.qsr_id=qr.Qsr_Id left join Qs_Type qt on qt.Qst_Id = qr.Qst_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = qr.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = qr.P_Id left join SYS_Company proc on proc.C_Id = pro.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Department prod on prod.D_Id = pro.P_Competent_Department left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = qr.Qsr_Duty_Cpy left join Sys_User u1 on u1.U_Id = qr.Qsr_Rectify_Uid left join Sys_File f on f.FileID = qr.Qsr_Id where qsscr.qssc_id = #{id} order by qsscr.Create_Time ASC

select pro.P_Name as pName, pro.P_Code as pCode, con.Con_Name as conName, con.Con_Code as conCode, c1.C_Name as ptContractorName, c1.C_Abbreviation as ptContractorAbbName, c2.C_Name as ptSupervisorName, c2.C_Abbreviation as ptSupervisorAbbName, c3.C_Name as ptEvaluationUnitName, c3.C_Abbreviation as ptEvaluationUnitAbbName, c4.C_Name as ptRectifyName, c4.C_Abbreviation as ptRectifyAbbName, u1.U_Name as ptPmName, u2.U_Name as ptCseName, qp.Qsp_Code as qspCode, qp.Qsp_Name as qspName, f.File_Relation_Id as fileRelationId, ,
from Qs_PT_Spot_Check mn left join Qs_Plan_Task qpt on mn.pt_id=qpt.id left join Qs_Plan qp on qp.Qsp_Id = qpt.Qsp_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id = qpt.P_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id = qpt.Con_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id = qpt.Pt_Contractor_Id left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id = qpt.Pt_Supervisor_Id left join SYS_Company c3 on c3.C_Id = qpt.Pt_Evaluation_Unit_Id left join SYS_Company c4 on c4.C_Id = qpt.Pt_Rectify_Cid left join Sys_User u1 on u1.U_Id = qpt.Pt_Pm left join Sys_User u2 on u2.U_Id = qpt.Pt_Cse left join Sys_File f on f.FileId = mn.id where mn.id = #{id} order by mn.create_time desc
